steps.label: Apply direct pressure
steps.text: Put firm, steady pressure directly on the arm wound now with a clean cloth or gauze. If blood is spurting, flowing continuously, or the person feels faint, call 911 now. Tell me when pressure is on.

steps.label: Find sterile gauze
steps.text: Keep firm pressure on the wound. If someone else can help, ask them to take sterile gauze from the bottom compartment; its light may turn on. If alone, keep pressing rather than reaching for the box. Tell me when you have the gauze or if bleeding is worsening.

steps.label: Keep pressure and seek care
steps.text: Keep steady pressure until bleeding stops. If it is heavy or does not stop, call 911 now. A deep or gaping wound needs medical evaluation; do not rely on this box alone.
